# Card Safe HQ

> Card Safe HQ (cardsafehq) is an online trading card seller. It sells graded singles, raw singles and sealed product through its eBay store, runs live breaks and auctions on Whatnot, and posts pickups, breaks and card restorations on Instagram and TikTok (@cardsafe.hq).

cardsafehq.com is the brand's home page and links to every place you can buy from or follow Card Safe HQ.

## Where to buy

- [Card Safe HQ eBay store](https://www.ebay.com/str/cardsafehq): graded slabs, raw singles and sealed product
- [Card Safe HQ on Whatnot](https://www.whatnot.com/user/cardsafehq): live breaks and auctions

## Follow

- [Instagram @cardsafe.hq](https://www.instagram.com/cardsafe.hq): pickups, breaks and restorations
- [TikTok @cardsafe.hq](https://www.tiktok.com/@cardsafe.hq): pickups, breaks and restorations
- [Staten News](https://statennews.com): TCG market coverage and articles
